reason: A web UI plugin that adds a left-side, virtualized message navigation rail for locating, previewing, and jumping to user messages in long DeepSeek Harness conversations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 长会话提供左侧消息导航轨道，支持预览历史用户消息并点击跳转。
summaries.en: Adds a left-side navigation rail to DeepSeek Harness conversations for previewing and jumping to historical user messages.

capabilities: Reads conversation history through the DSH history API
Displays indexed user-message previews in a navigation rail
Loads older conversation pages when a user selects an unloaded message
Changes chat-view scrolling and message highlighting
